title: Left scalar/pullback route in fixed ordinary Roos coordinates
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W,f, a source calculus SE, normalized completed operations ML with coefficients L, and a normalized scalar model SY at Y [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let K be an integral constructible object, eP:Q(P) iso K a good presentation, (C,eC,kappa) a coherent quotient presentation of P, and q a strict nested scalar/pullback quotient comparison satisfying the tensor-unit formula [stage3-pur-scalar-pullback-roos-coordinates]. Assume l invertible on X,Y and derived E-pullback of K complete. Postcompose the route completed-scalar/pullback comparison, L-pullback realization, and L-pullback of scalarReduction(SY), with the inverse scalar/pullback system comparison and the explicit scalarPullbackRoosCoordinate. The resulting morphism equals scalarPullbackRoosChain: inverse scalar completion at X, ordinary scalar of E-pullback of eP inverse, ordinary scalar of the canonical E-pullback comparison on P, ordinary-scalar localization factor, and Q(scalarPullbackChain(P)). This calculation involves SY and ML, with no scalar realization at X or E-pullback realization.

proof.text: Precompose with the scalar-completion isomorphism on E-pullback(K), cancelling the inverse in scalarPullbackCompleted. Move the remaining scalar-completion map at Y through the L-pullback realization by naturality. Normalize SY on (P,C,eC,kappa), and normalize L-pullback on ordinary scalar(P), choosing a good replacement where necessary; the whole-system transposes compare the replacements. The ordinary scalar/pullback comparison is normalized by the canonical scalarPullbackChain on P.

The scalar-completion augmentation is tensor unit in the unshifted coordinate and zero in the shifted coordinate. The formula for q identifies the resulting strict quotient maps on nested tensor-unit/pullback generators; linearity and sheafification give their equality before derived localization. Preserve all transition maps, apply the Roos functor, and use Roos bridge naturality. Transport along eP and cancel the source scalar-completion isomorphism to obtain precisely scalarPullbackRoosChain.
